summary: Coincheck Group N.V., the Amsterdam-domiciled Nasdaq-listed holding company for Japanese crypto exchange Coincheck, furnished a routine Form 6-K monthly operating disclosure covering October 2025 through September 2026. Figures include monthly exchange trading volume, marketplace trading volume, customer assets, and verified accounts, ending September 2026 at ¥217,839 million exchange volume, ¥12,210 million marketplace volume, ¥876,931 million customer assets, and 2,868,544 verified accounts. The release is preliminary, unaudited, subject to revision, and posts to the company website. No transaction, board recommendation, advisor, or deal terms are disclosed; no special-situation angle applies.
